title: Adaptive Nesterov Momentum Method for Electrical Impedance Tomography with the Complete Electrode Model
summary: We apply the adaptive Nesterov momentum (ANM) method [30] to electrical impedance tomography under the complete electrode model. The forward problem is formulated in the variational CEM setting, accounting for finite electrode size, contact impedance, insulating gaps, and the mean-free voltage gauge.
